# The Wonder Agency

> The Wonder Agency is a London digital marketing agency that specialises in hospitality: restaurants, hotels, bars and pubs, restaurant groups, and food and drink brands. One team runs content creation (photography and video), social media management, paid advertising (Meta and Google), SEO and AI search, influencer marketing, website design and email marketing, with one goal: more bookings. It works across London, the UK and internationally, and built its own AI search visibility tool, Wonder Score (wonderscore.ai).

Key facts:
- Based in London, United Kingdom; part of The Wonder Group. Founded by Charles Morris and Charlotte Giles.
- Specialism: hospitality and lifestyle brands, from Michelin-starred restaurants to hotel groups and independents.
- Results: one restaurant grew annual revenue from £3.2m to £4.6m over three years; a hotel group grew year-on-year food and beverage revenue by 58% in three months, with room bookings up 26%; a Michelin-starred restaurant grew mid-week set lunch bookings by 95% in three months; a three-restaurant group grew Q4 revenue by 18%; a new Saturday brunch in a historic City venue with no weekend trade reached 220 to 250 covers every Saturday within six weeks; the relaunch of Phil Howard’s The Square cookbooks, website and campaign by the agency, sold out within 48 hours.
- Offers a free marketing audit for restaurants, hotels and bars: https://thewonderagency.co/contact/
- Contact: hello@thewonder.group, +44 777 502 2514

## Services
- [Hospitality Marketing Services](https://thewonderagency.co/services/): Content, social media, paid ads, SEO and AI search, websites and email for restaurants, hotels and bars. Everything you need to get more bookings, from one team.
- [Content Creation for Restaurants, Hotels & Bars](https://thewonderagency.co/services/content-creation/): Photography and video for restaurants, hotels and bars: food, drinks, interiors, team and reels, planned around what you need to sell and made for social, ads, web and email.
- [Restaurant Photography & Video](https://thewonderagency.co/services/content-creation/restaurants/): Restaurant photography and video: dish, drink, interior and team shoots and reels, shot around service in your dining room and made for Instagram, TikTok, delivery apps, Google and your website.
- [Email Marketing for Restaurants, Hotels & Bars](https://thewonderagency.co/services/email-marketing/): Newsletters and automated emails for restaurants, hotels and bars that bring guests back: list growth, segmentation, campaigns and automated flows.
- [Email Marketing for Hotels](https://thewonderagency.co/services/email-marketing/hotels/): Email marketing for hotels: pre-arrival and post-stay emails, seasonal breaks, dining and events campaigns, sent to the right guests to bring them back and grow direct bookings.
- [Influencer Marketing for Restaurants, Hotels & Bars](https://thewonderagency.co/services/influencer-marketing/): Influencer marketing for restaurants, hotels and bars: the right local creators, briefed properly, with clear disclosure and reporting on reach, engagement and bookings.
- [Paid Advertising for Restaurants, Hotels & Bars](https://thewonderagency.co/services/paid-advertising/): Meta and Google ads for restaurants, hotels and bars, judged on bookings and revenue rather than clicks, with full conversion tracking.
- [Meta & Google Ads for Restaurants](https://thewonderagency.co/services/paid-advertising/restaurants/): Meta and Google ads for restaurants: Instagram, Facebook and Google campaigns that fill set lunches, quiet nights and private dining, tracked to the booking.
- [SEO & AI Search (GEO) for Restaurants, Hotels & Bars](https://thewonderagency.co/services/seo-ai-search/): Get found on Google and Google Maps, and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. SEO and generative engine optimisation for restaurants, hotels and bars, tracked with Wonder Score.
- [Restaurant SEO & AI Search](https://thewonderagency.co/services/seo-ai-search/restaurants/): Restaurant SEO: rank in Google and Google Maps for the searches diners make, and get recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Tracked with Wonder Score.
- [Social Media Management for Restaurants, Hotels & Bars](https://thewonderagency.co/services/social-media-management/): We run Instagram, TikTok and Facebook for restaurants, hotels and bars: strategy, daily posting, comments and messages, and monthly reporting tied to bookings.
- [Social Media Management for Hotels](https://thewonderagency.co/services/social-media-management/hotels/): Social media management for hotels: Instagram, TikTok and Facebook that sell the whole hotel, from rooms to the restaurant, bar, events and weddings.
- [Social Media Management for Restaurants](https://thewonderagency.co/services/social-media-management/restaurants/): Social media management for restaurants: Instagram, TikTok and Facebook run daily, with reels that make people hungry, every message answered and reporting tied to covers.
- [Website Design for Restaurants, Hotels & Bars](https://thewonderagency.co/services/website-design/): Fast, mobile-first websites for restaurants, hotels and bars, built around bookings: menus that work on a phone, booking system integration, SEO foundations and ongoing updates.
- [Restaurant Website Design](https://thewonderagency.co/services/website-design/restaurants/): Restaurant website design: fast, mobile-first sites with menus as readable pages, your booking system built in, and the details search engines and AI need to recommend you.

## Work and results
- [Our Work](https://thewonderagency.co/work/): Selected photography, video and websites for restaurants, hotels, bars and food and drink brands, plus six case studies: £3.2m to £4.6m annual revenue, +58% hotel F&B revenue, +95% set lunch bookings and more.
- [Hotel Marketing Case Study: F&B Revenue Up 58% in Three Months](https://thewonderagency.co/work/hotel-boost/): Hotel, three months. Food and beverage revenue up 58% year on year, with room bookings up 26%.
- [Michelin Restaurant Marketing Case Study: Set Lunch Bookings Up 95%](https://thewonderagency.co/work/michelin-star-set-menu/): Michelin-starred restaurant, three months. Set lunch bookings up 95% after reshaping the set menu with the chef and a full campaign.
- [Restaurant Group Marketing Case Study: Q4 Revenue Up 18%](https://thewonderagency.co/work/restaurant-group-marketing-overhaul/): Three-restaurant group, Q4. An 18% year-on-year increase in revenue after a full marketing overhaul.
- [Restaurant Marketing Case Study: £3.2m to £4.6m Revenue](https://thewonderagency.co/work/restaurant-revenue-growth/): Restaurant, three years. Annual revenue from £3.2m to £4.6m, Instagram from 3,000 to 20,000+ followers and Google rating from 4.0 to 4.6.
- [Brunch Launch Case Study: 220–250 Covers Every Saturday in Six Weeks](https://thewonderagency.co/work/saturday-brunch-launch/): Historic City venue, six weeks. A new Saturday brunch now does 220 to 250 covers every week, from no weekend trade at all.
- [The Square Cookbooks Relaunch: Sold Out in 48 Hours](https://thewonderagency.co/work/the-square-cookbooks/): Cookbook relaunch, October 2025. We built the website and launch campaign for Phil Howard’s The Square cookbooks; the limited run sold out within 48 hours.
